1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker and a polymer having anionic sites.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from zirconium, aluminum, titanium, chromium, and iron compounds__.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __and wherein the amount of polyanion relative to polyalkylenimine is controlled to achieve a predetermined charge state__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to crosslink said polymer having anionic sites__.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __and wherein said nanoparticle exhibits delayed release kinetics when contacted with said polymer__.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater, __and wherein said nanoparticles release said crosslinker in a time-dependent manner upon contact with said polymer__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker and a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked by said crosslinker__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, __wherein said multivalent cation is released in a delayed manner upon contact with said polymer__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, __wherein the release of said multivalent cation is controlled by the composition and charge state of said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __selected from polyacrylic acid, sodium polyacrylate, or copolymers thereof__.

23) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a degree of hydrolysis between 20% and 40%__.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein said polymer is present in an amount sufficient to be crosslinked by the multivalent cation crosslinker in said composition of claim 1__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said fluid is brine or seawater, __and wherein the composition exhibits delayed gelling upon aging due to controlled release of said multivalent cation crosslinker from said nanoparticle__.
